title: A Speeder Bike Pilot
description: A Speeder Biker Pilot (front) is in a costume sketch by Nilo Rodis-Jamero. The final design of the bike, which went through scores of permutations, was a joint effort of Rodis-Jamero and Joe Johnston. While several full-sized bikes were built, the most chilling moments in the bike chase scene took place aboard three-foot miniatures. John Mollo sketched the Imperial Admiral (back).
